reason: I already keep a spreadsheet and it works, and I am not going to upload my card statement PDF or slip photos to an app I have never used. Even if the PDF is read in the browser, I cannot check that from the outside, so I would not start.
objection: I cannot verify that my statement stays on my device. Once I hand over data to a new app, I have no way of knowing what happens to it.
would_change_my_mind: A way to check for myself, without trusting their word, that the statement and slip text never leave my phone or browser, plus a free trial I can use without uploading anything real.
